annotations.title: List open grant and funding calls

description: List grant and funding calls that are currently open for applications (status, deadline, provider, support amount, focus areas), including Turkish, EU and international programmes. All open calls can be paged through with nextCursor. Applications are made with the provider; hangel only lists the call.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call of this tool, to get the next page. Other arguments can be omitted; if given, they must match that call.

language.description: Optional. Returns the name and summary in this language where hangel has a stored translation (marked translated: true); other calls stay in their original language.

limit.description: Maximum number of results in this page (default 30, at most 100).

query.description: Matched against name, provider, focus areas and summary. Turkish or English, or German, Spanish, French, Arabic, Russian, Persian, Azerbaijani, Hungarian, Hausa or Danish.

sort.description: "deadline": closing soonest first, then rolling, then unconfirmed deadlines (default); "recentlyVerified": most recently checked first; "name": alphabetical.

name: list_open_funds

asOf.description: Time the statuses and dates were evaluated (ISO 8601).

contentLanguage.description: BCP 47 code of the language the text fields are written in, as stored on hangel (for example "tr" or "en"); "und" when it cannot be determined. Texts are not machine-translated unless "translated" is true.

deadline.description: Last day to apply (YYYY-MM-DD); null for rolling or unconfirmed deadlines.

deadlineNeedsCheck.description: true when the deadline is more than 12 months away and should be confirmed with the provider.

originalLanguage.description: Language of the original name and summary.

status.description: "open": dated call whose deadline has not passed; "rolling": applications accepted continuously; "open_deadline_unconfirmed": listed as open but the deadline could not be read from the official source, confirm with the provider.

translated.description: true only when the name and summary were replaced by a translation stored on hangel; the original language is then in originalLanguage.

url.description: Public page of the record on hangel.org.

verified.description: false when the call was found by automatic scanning and not yet reviewed by hangel.

verifiedAt.description: Last day hangel checked the official source.

hasMore.description: true when more records follow; call again with nextCursor.

language.description: Requested language for names and summaries.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page.

offset.description: Position of the first record of this page in the full result.

query.description: Present when a query was given.

expansion.description: Query terms that were matched across languages through the hangel multilingual dictionary, and the forms searched in the content.

normalized.description: The query after case, accent and punctuation normalisation (the raw query is not echoed).

returned.description: Number of records in this page.

title: List open grant and funding calls
